title: Lars Bergstrom - Beyond Safety and Speed: How Rust Fuels Team Productivity
summary: Lars Bergstrom of Google presents how Rust improves team productivity beyond safety and speed, with data on rewrites, defects and review. It compares Rust teams to those on legacy native languages and Go.
why: Used as a source for Google's data that Rust matches Go productivity with fewer defects.

categories.name: C, C++, Rust, Go & systems languages

quote.text: found no measurable difference in productivity between teams using Rust vs Go
